offer.text: I've no trade and no coin, but I've got neighbors I care about, and there's three of the dead shambling too near our doors. You've a strong arm — would you see them off?

accept.text: Thank you kindly. I'll keep folk indoors till it's done.

decline.text: Fair enough. Not everyone's a fighter.

in_progress.text: Still a couple of them lurching about out there.

ready.text: All three? You've a brave heart, friend.

complete.text: I can't pay you what a lord would, but you've my thanks and a neighbor's loyalty. That's worth something.
